title: Laredo Firefighters Take Top Honors at HYROX Competition
excerpt: Members of the Laredo Fire Department competed in a HYROX fitness competition hosted by Triumph Fit in Laredo on Nov. 13, taking top honors in both the men's doubles and mixed doubles divisions.
content:
Members of the Laredo Fire Department took top honors at a HYROX fitness competition hosted by Triumph Fit in Laredo on Friday, Nov. 13.

In the men's doubles division, Joey Castillo and Nick Ramos finished first. In the mixed doubles division, Alexa Castaneda and David Ramirez took the top spot.

HYROX is a fitness race that combines running with functional workout stations, testing strength and endurance.

Source: Laredo Fire Department, Nov. 13, 2026.
